pages.transcription:
Taft Hotel
Newhaven, Conn.                                     17.2.41

Dear Hanna u Manfred, I have written you two days ago about Eva's
schools. In the meantime I phoned her and Mrs. Sch. and heard
that everything is alright. This week I expect information about
her music lessons - that is to say, new teacher - and also, whether and
when she has holidays and in March, and I suppose we will then take
her here although besides us there are no attractions in Newhaven.
There is not much to report from here. The weather is rather bad at the
moment, storm or snow or cold alternatively, so we work quietly
without any desire to go out. We had Maass here for two days this
afternoon comes Thornton Wilder, Wednesday Landshof who just phoned
that he has seen Manfred before leaving and we are naturally
impatient to meet him. Saturday we may go up to Newyork to see
the publisher as well as a "Fidelio" performance conducted by Bruno
Walter. - We had no letter from you last week, but as the clipper
arrived yesterday, I hope to get one to-morrow.
                                     Best love and kisses Lotte
Please give the attached letter to Rauman's.

Dear Mr. and Mrs. Rauman,
                                     Newhaven, 17.2.41
I am glad to hear that you have become faithful Bethonians
and it is a good feeling to know you at "Rosemount", keeping Mama
company and I hope, enjoying Bath as we always did. Hanna wrote me
that the children were acting Mr. Rauman's play, and this information
combined with the fact that you also like coffee, gives me complete
assurance that our tradition is being maintained. I hope that your
pets are on good terms with the children and suppose that they enjoy
being in the country. Stefan has just written a short story - the main
character a bulldog, the setting the Kenneth-Avon canal (is the name
right, I have half forgotten it already) in a house on the hill to Bethampton,
I am sure you would like this combination of families landscape
and dog psychology. It gave Stefan pleasure to write it and kept me
busy in Newyork besides my other activities of resettling Eva and
flat-hunting in Newhaven. I have been successful with Eva, I
believe, but unsuccessful in finding a flat, and so we are continuing
our hotel life which gets more complicated in the degree as papers,
necessary books and manuscripts accumulate. But we are enjoying
being again in a smaller town, seeing snow and having cold fresh air,
and the greatest pleasure are the books. - Once more: we are very happy to
know you in our house and hope that you will continue to enjoy it in relative
peacefulness and quiet. 
                                     Kindest regards from us both, Lotte Zweig
pages.notes: Brief auf rosa Papier. Am linken Rand vertikal geschriebene Notizen: 'We enclose a letter of Eva's which just arrived' (oben) und 'Kindest regards Stefan Zweig' (unten).
Farbskala und Grauskala für Archivierung. Das Dokument liegt unter der Skala.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar, die Handschrift ist klar. Die vertikalen Randnotizen wurden korrekt zugeordnet.
